Volume XLIV - Number 12                             Page 2                                 December 31, 2024

COLONY, HONEY PLANT AND MARKET CONDITIONS
CALIFORNIA
Colonies in the Central Valley were being fed and readied for almond pollination contracts. Demand for bulk
honey was light and prices were mostly steady.
FLORIDA
Beekeepers reported cool, dry conditions. Colonies were building up on maple and willow. Packer demand was
slow ahead of the holidays.
MIDWEST
Most colonies were wintering in cold storage or outdoors with good stores. Trading in bulk white honey was light.
